Noah Kim: Quick one - Prospect wants a single RFI cell that explains 'fallback behavior, worst-case monthly delta, and a one-line legal clause' for a 30 qps chat POC. Can we draft?

Priya Patel: Short matrix row: 'Dedicated primary; optional controlled fallback to hosted (opt-in). Region-restricted; audit trail; drain default 300s.'

Marta Rivera: Numbers (conservative): Dedicated p99 ~220-260ms; fallback-hosted p99 ~300-380ms. Note: seq length sensitive.

CostBot: Pricing cells: baseline (Dedicated 2x mid-GPU) $16,000/mo. Typical overflow (10% steady) +$1.8k/mo (+11%). Worst-case (72h,50% overflow) +$8.5k (+53%).

legal-bot: One-line clause: 'Controlled fallback is opt-in and requires a signed addendum; Redwood's liability for cross-region processing is limited where Customer has authorized fallback in writing.'

Priya Patel: Append small YAML snippet for appendix: ```yaml
routing_policy:
  primary: dedicated-cluster
  fallback: hosted-lowlatency
  fallback_conditions: [util>0.85, p99>250ms]
  drain_seconds: 300
```

Noah Kim: Awesome. I'll add to the RFI bundle and attach redacted SOC + network diagram. Sending to prospect by EOD. :thumbsup:
